name: ABR Telecom Consulta Número (current operator after portability; manual, CAPTCHA)
operator: ABR Telecom (Associação Brasileira de Recursos em Telecomunicações)
tier_rationale: ABR Telecom administers the Brazilian number-portability reference database for the operators under Anatel regulation; published consultation page (A8 trusted); P128 cond 5 'ABR Telecom trusted'.

reliability.justification: Authoritative source of the current operator of a ported Brazilian number (read manually by the analyst; V3LUM never automates it).

consulta_numero.title: Consulta Número landing page (reCAPTCHA form; static manual link for +55 numbers)

terms.quote: The current operator after portability is available only manually through ABR Telecom's 'consulta numero portado' page (reCAPTCHA): a manual pivot link (P128), never automated.

consulta_numero.notes: Quote: binding council text (P126 cond 7). URL verified 2026-11-26 (GET of the landing page only, nothing submitted): 200, 'Consulta Número', a reCAPTCHA widget and a POST form with a CSRF token and a 'telefone' field, so no URL parameter can carry the number. The link is therefore static: opening it sends nothing, and the analyst types the number on the page (A9: CAPTCHA walls are manual links only, never automated or bypassed). Used by pivots_phone (+55 phone seeds of an opted-in case).

notes: Owned by batch p1-G06-1 (P126 cond 7, P128 cond 1 and 5). Manual link only: V3LUM never requests consultanumero.abrtelecom.com.br.
